summary: Request: add/update approved Enterprise Security RFP snippets in Generic Response Tool (GRT)
description:
Request to add/update standardized RFP response snippets in the Generic Response Tool (GRT) used by AEs/SEs.

Background:
We are refreshing the Enterprise Security Enablement Kit and need GRT to reflect the same approved language. Field is currently copy/pasting from older docs, which is causing version drift (esp. ISO wording, data residency nuance, and audit log export claims).

Request scope:
1) Create a new snippet pack: "Enterprise Security (2026)" with curated blocks by category.
2) Deprecate/redirect older snippets tagged "Security FAQ 2024/2025" to reduce accidental use.
3) Add guardrails: a short header on each snippet reminding users to not modify compliance claims without review + link to evidence request process.

Categories + required snippet titles (exact):
A. Security Program
- "Security program overview (SOC 2)"
- "Vulnerability management + penetration testing (approved wording)"
- "Incident response + breach notification (non-contractual overview)"

B. Data Protection & Data Use
- "Data use: no training on customer data (definition + caveats)"
- "Data retention + deletion (deployment-mode specific)"
- "Subprocessors + DPA request pointer"

C. Encryption & Key Management
- "Encryption in transit"
- "Encryption at rest"
- "Customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM) by deployment mode"

D. Access Controls
- "SSO/SAML + supported IdPs"
- "SCIM provisioning"
- "RBAC model and granularity (Console + API)"

E. Audit Logging
- "Audit log coverage (events)"
- "Audit log export (SIEM/S3) + limitations"
- "Audit log retention controls"

F. Deployment Modes / Shared Responsibility
- "Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private: shared responsibility summary"
- "Private deployment (VPC/on-prem) security overview (approved)"

Non-goals:
- Do not add any roadmap or "on-request" capabilities that are not supported today.
- Do not include contractual commitments; only describe current capabilities/processes.

Content source of truth:
Snippets must match the latest approved language in the Enterprise Security Enablement Kit (Confluence/Drive). If any conflicts are found, pause and escalate to Security/GRC for clarification.

Acceptance criteria:
- All snippet titles above exist in GRT under a single pack labeled "Enterprise Security (2026)".
- Each snippet includes a "Last reviewed" date and owner line.
- Each snippet includes a link to the Confluence index page for canonical references.
- Older "Security FAQ 2024/2025" snippets are either removed from search results or clearly marked "Deprecated - do not use".
- Sales/SE users can filter by category and copy snippets without losing formatting (bullets preserved).
- Audit log export snippet explicitly states supported export destinations and avoids implying every event type is available in every deployment by default.
- ISO snippet language does NOT claim certification; it must be framed as alignment-only unless explicitly certified.

Requested due date:
By 2026-02-18 (needed for Nordbank and Aurora Financial questionnaire/RFP workflows).

Approvers for snippet content:
- Security/GRC: Marcus Lin, Olga Petrov
- Product Security PM: Naomi Feldman
- Messaging: Camila Reyes

Notes:
If GRT cannot support per-snippet "Last reviewed" metadata, add it as the first line of the snippet body.
